reviews.t: Works for moderate to severe dry skin/eczema
reviews.x: I started using cerave about 7 yrs ago at the recommendation of my dermatologist.  There is no better product out there over the counter.  No other moisturizer works for me since my skin is super sensitive to oils, fragrance etc.

Cerave is the #1 recommended skin care product by Dermatologists. The specific formula of this cream is geared toward moisturizing sensitive dry skin and is void of any perfumes or dyes which is one of the leading causes of contact dermatitis. All of Cerave products are excellent!  The Seller of Discount Depot packages these tubs with pumps extremely well!  Buying pump devices such as these Online can be a recipe for disaster. Not with this Seller. I have purchased this dual package 4 times now

This stuff is the BEST! After menopause, my skin was horribly dry and almost scaly - so gross. I use this all over and last time I went to the dermatologist for a checkup he was amazed at how hydrated my skin was. I've been using it for a while, but I believe it cleared up very quickly. I love that it is unscented and non-greasy. Just slather it on and wait a couple of minutes for it to absorb.

Product arrived in a timely manner.  Great lotion, works great and treats rough dry skin better than other lotions I’ve tried.  Would recommend for anyone looking for a lotion to treat dry skin.  Even works on dry cracked feet. My skin has never felt so soft.
Love this product. BAD  customer service EVER. Products are great . Just BAD customer service. Hope everyone get products with No damage🙏

All rate cerave moisturizing cream a 10 out of 10. I am 57 and have used more moisturizers than I can count including most for sensitive skin. I have been using this product for most of 2 years and even my dermatologist says my face has never looked better. It has also ended the dry flakiness on my legs in between moisturizing. Very happy with the supplier and especially the large size containers

reviews.t: NON-GREASY BUT THICK, LOVE THE PUMP!
reviews.x: This is not a lightweight cream; it goes on thick and rich, but it is not AT ALL greasy, and it absorbs fast. If your skin gets a tad flaky after showering, this is what you need. With the handy pump, there’s no unhygienic finger-dipping to contaminate the remainder in the jar, and with the two jar set there’ll be no sharing yours with HIM (and no issue as to who should order it FOR him)—CeraVe seems to have considered every salient point! Buy the set, keep the man. Maybe.

reviews.t: Cerave cream is a great choice for sensitive skin.
reviews.x: It's a bit expensive but it works well. It's  not greasy and moisturizes nicely.  I like the pump on the jar.

reviews.t: It have no fragrance or any harmful ingredients that would irritate the skin.
reviews.x: I use cerave all over my body including my face to keep my skin hydrated.

I suffer from an allergic dermatitis that makes my skin unbearably  itchy.  Probably due to our dog's dander and saliva.  I have gone to a number of reputable allergists and dermatologists to no avail.  All the prescription creams they gave me were useless, as were all the OTC creams and lotions I tried. I learned about CeraVe from a friend whose dermatologist did suggest it, while none of my doctors ever mentioned it.  It is simply a miracle for me.  Deeply penetrates the skin on my hands and f

I have only been using this product for about a week and I already see a difference in my skin. My skin is softer and my knees and elbows are lighter in color (they match the rest of my arms/legs) much better. I'm very glad that I got a set of two. One thing that I would say is that I notice that it burned a little at first. That's the hyaluronic acid I guess. I have to be more careful about wearing sunscreen too. But I don't really see either of these things as cons. I would definitely recommen

This is a great skin cream. My husband and I have used it on and off for years, but now, as I age, my skin is becoming somewhat dry and flaky and my doctor was concerned. I have since found that, used daily, Cera Ve completely solves this problem--100%! I am very pleased  with such an easy solution to my problem, and it feels wonderful!

My dermatologist recommended that I use this Cerave cream instead of their regular lotion. It's made a big difference and I expect to use this from now on. The pump is great. I got one with a pump and then I can just get the jars from here out. It really works well.

I've always liked Cerave Moisturizing Lotion, but I like the Cream better.  The dispenser is the best.  I can control how much comes out.  AND, you don't need much.  A little goes a long way.  The Cream really repairs my hands.  This is a great product.

The pump for this moisturizing cream works great and is so convenient.  The cream quickly is absorbed into the fingers and skin.  I bought this for my cuticles and split fingertips that happen to me every winter.  Highly recommend it.
The product did not include the pumps as indicated, nor does it say the creme is unscented.  It has a chemical smell to it.  Also, this was a 2 pack and the seal on one of them was broken.
This moisturizer far outweighs the lotion.  Not heavier but richer.  It slid on smoothly and really penetrates.  Works well.
This works wonders for my husbands dry skin.

reviews.t: Great product, seller has no clue how to package it
reviews.x: One of the containers was already ruptured and mostly spilled out upon arrival. The packaging was OBVIOUSLY insufficient just based on visual inspection. They basically put the lotion containers into a bag, and shove it into a box with barely enough packaging to prevent the box from rattling.... Not particularly impressed.  I do however love the product, it's great stuff!

Cerave is great for sensitive, very dry skin. It’s very thick but soaks in quickly and doesn’t leave a messy, sticky residue. It relieves that tight, itchy, dry skin feeling, instantly. My skin looks and feels better after using for just a couple days. The pump makes it especially easy to use and it has a nice, fresh scent.

This cream is amazing if you have dry skin. Apply right after shower and skin will absorb in less than 5 mins., you won't feel the after application stickiness. However, BJs has the 19oz bottle with pump for $15 and they often have coupons. The 3 stars is because of the price on this listing not the product.

I could not say enough good things about this lotion. It is amazing in every way. I'm a burn survivor with about 85% of my body affected so my skin gets extremely unbearably dry  and this lotion is my daily life saver. You cannot go wrong with this product. I'll probably use it the rest of my life.

I cannot recommend Cerave Body Cream more enthusiastically. I began using it about a year ago and almost immediately noticed a difference in my skin. It goes on easily, despite its thickness and absorbs quickly. I can see the difference in the flexibility and suppleness of my skin. Love it.

reviews.t: Nice nighttime cream &better than some high end products
reviews.x: This is so luxurious feeling on my skin at night. I wake up to supple beautifully moisturized skin. It is a crucial part of my nightly routine. Plus it does not smell bad like some other high end moisturizers that smell like fish to me. It doesn’t really have any scent. I love it

This product was one that a dermatologist recommended for very dry skin. I bought it and love it!  My skin feels very soft all day. I will buy more when this is done. Its also beneficial for my great granddaughter with her exzema. Moisturizes well

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the cream for effectively treating dry, rough, and sensitive skin, including eczema and dermatitis.
Many reviewers highlight that it is fragrance-free and non-irritating, making it suitable for sensitive skin.
Reviewers frequently mention that dermatologists recommended or endorsed the product.
The pump dispenser is commonly praised as convenient and hygienic.
A few reviewers note the cream is thick and rich yet non-greasy and absorbs quickly.
